mentions.name: drep-ai
mentions.description: A code review app powered by local or self-hosted LLMs, similar to Greptile or Copilot, that reviews and lints code with additional capabilities those tools lack.
mentions.problem: Started as a way to lint the author's own code, addressing gaps in existing AI code review tools like Greptile and Copilot.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my own code review app powered by local or self hosted LLMs. It started as a way to lint my own code and took off from there. It's basically like greptile or co-pilot, but has some things that they don't:
